I think we have need new requirement.

Problem - some widespread frameworks (like Drupal and WordPress) have functionality to install/update/delete modules. It's ok for development environment it but should be disabled for production environment.

If to take requirement V14.3.2 as an example:

> V14.3.2 Verify that web or application server and application framework debug modes are disabled in production to eliminate debug features, developer consoles, and unintended security disclosures. 

Rough proposal idea is (please improve wording):

V14.3.X Verify that application framework development modes and functionalities are disabled to eliminate possibility to add, change or remove functionality.
